name: 龔宇睿
objective:
分析化學涉及分離、鑑定和測定樣品中各組分的相對含量。定性分析著重於樣品中物質的化學組成，而定量分析則關注測量樣品中各組分的相對含量。分離步驟通常是定性分析和定量分析的必要組成部分。
Analytical chemistry involes separating, identifying, and determining the relative amounts of the components in a sample of matter. Qualitative analysis is concerned with the chemical identify of the species in the sample and quantitative analysis is concerned with to mearsure the relative amounts of the components in a sample.A separation step is usually a necessary part of both a qualitative and a quantitative analysis.
schedule:
Week 01 Basic Introduction
Week 02 Experimental Error/Statics
Week 03 Statics 
Week 04 Chemical Equilibrium Titrimetry
Week 05 Gravimetric Analysis
Week 06 Buffers & Acid-Base Titrations
Week 07 Acid-Base Titrations
Week 08 EDTA Titrations
Week 09 Midterm Exam
Week 10 Electrode Potentials
Week 11 Potentiometry
Week 12 Electrochemistry I
Week 13 Electrochemistry II
Week 14 Spectrophometry I
Week 15 Spectrophometry II
Week 16 Atomic Spectroscopy
Week 17 Chromatoography
Week 18 Final Exam
